**STEP 3 - Items:** Whole almonds only (about 40-45 pieces). No oil, dressing, or sauce is visible.

**STEP 4 - Area:** The almonds are loosely clustered in the centre and cover roughly 20% of the plate, about 63 cm².

**STEP 5 - Volume:** Almonds are about 1 cm thick and piled about 1.2 cm high on average. 63 cm² × 1.2 cm ≈ 75 ml (gross).

**STEP 6 - Grams:** Whole nuts pack loosely, so I use a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml (close to the cut-fruit range). 75 ml × 0.6 ≈ 45 g. A piece count gives a similar figure: about 42 almonds × ~1.2 g ≈ 50 g. I take ~48 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Raw almonds are about 579 kcal/100 g. 48 g × 5.79 ≈ 278 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** About 48 g (roughly 40 almonds) on a small side plate with partial coverage is plausible. A fifth of the plate, not a full serving, is visible, so the estimate stays in that range.
